purpose: Explain that circumstances leave no room for an activity.
keywords: N / V dictionary + どころではない
With the deadline approaching, I cannot possibly think about a trip.
My fever is so high that studying is out of the question.
The shop was so busy that a break was out of the question.
formation: N / V dictionary + どころではない
restrictions: A stronger concern or constraint prevents the activity.
mistake: This is stronger than simply not wanting to do something.
